system.description: As a reaction to a hostile creature moving within 15 feet of you, you exhale a Solid Fog, creating a 15-foot radius of haze, centering on you. Select one of its original effects to apply as part of this use. Also, if a hostile creature makes a saving throw vs a Genjutsu with the Inhale keyword while inside the Solid Fog, they make their saving throw at disadvantage.
